jobs.description:
Do you have a strong interest in cyber security and enjoy turning new insights and knowledge into ways of improvement? At Collectia, we are looking for a hands-on security professional with the ability to work across a broad technical remit and help move our security programme forward.

In this role, you will be the main contributor across a range of cyber security initiatives, working closely with experienced colleagues in DevOps, Engineering and IT Support, as well as external specialists. The position covers infrastructure, cloud, identity, endpoints and operational processes, combining technical security engineering with governance and compliance. You will help define effective controls and make sure they are implemented in practice.

Your key responsibilities

• Own and continuously develop our CIS 18 framework, including gap assessments, prioritised action plans, implementation follow-up and maturity reporting.

• Own and improve our Microsoft Secure Score and drive relevant security improvements across Microsoft 365 and Azure.

• Act as a central technical partner for ISAE 3000 activities, including audit preparation, evidence collection, control walkthroughs and remediation.

• Establish, document, maintain and test internal IT and security controls, ensuring that control design and evidence remain practical, consistent and traceable.

• Perform security risk assessments and drive remediation plans through to completion in collaboration with relevant colleagues.

• Plan, coordinate and carry out penetration tests and attack simulations together with external security experts and ethical hackers, and translate findings into concrete improvements with our technical teams.

• Investigate and implement technical security improvements based on developments in threats, vulnerabilities and defensive capabilities.

• Support the handling of security incidents, including investigation, containment, lessons learned and improvements to controls, monitoring and procedures.

Security domains in scope

The role spans identity and privileged access management, multifactor authentication, vulnerability management, logging and detection, incident management, endpoint and network security, server hardening, and cloud security across Microsoft 365 and Azure. It also includes security controls, risk management and audit readiness.

You will be part of

You will join our DevOps department in a role with significant influence on how security is designed, implemented and operated. You will work closely with technical colleagues and relevant business stakeholders, with direct access to decision-makers and opportunity to shape our security roadmap and ways of working.

We offer high professional standards, short decision paths, and opportunities for continuous professional development and knowledge sharing. Benefits include a lunch scheme, pension, health insurance, an in-house hairdresser and masseur, carwash and fitness subscription.

How we imagine you

Above all, you have a strong interest in cyber security. You are curious about emerging threats, new technologies and security developments, and you enjoy investigating how things work, and turning that knowledge into practical improvements.

We are open to different levels of experience. If you are earlier in your cyber security career but have a strong technical foundation, the right mindset and the ambition to grow into broader ownership, we would still be very interested in hearing from you.

You bring:

• Hands-on experience in cyber security, infrastructure security or a comparable technical security role.

• An interest in working across multiple security domains, with the initiative to investigate unfamiliar issues and involve the right colleagues or specialists when needed.

• An understanding of Microsoft security capabilities across Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Azure, including Secure Score, identity protection and privileged access.

• A practical approach to risk, balancing security, operational impact, cost and business priorities.

• The ability to take ownership, manage several initiatives at once and follow actions through to completion.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical specialists and non-technical stakeholders in Danish and English.

Experience with control frameworks such as CIS 18, and with audit preparation or remediation in an ISAE 3000, ISO 27001, NIS2 or similar environment is an advantage.

You do not need to be a specialist in every security domain from day one. What matters most is that you enjoy being hands-on, stay curious, challenge existing configurations constructively and work with others to implement sustainable improvements.

Ready to join our team?

Please send us your CV. We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right person.

For questions, please contact Oliver Pedersen, Team Lead DevOps by phone (+45) 30 29 07 22.

Location and terms

• Full-time, 37 hours per week, based in Brøndby

• Salary will reflect your qualifications and experience

• Clean criminal record and no registrations with credit information agencies

Want to get to know us better?

Start by watching a short video about Collectia, and then explore our mission, vision, and values.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Are you eager to join a growing biotech company of currently about 25 enthusiastic employees? Enduro Genetics is a world-leading biotech at the interface of synthetic biology and biomanufacturing with Enduro Sense, a transformative gene technology that redefines the capabilities of cells in fermentation. Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

We work with industrial clients who biomanufacture products using bacteria and yeasts to make their great processes even better.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Fermentation Scientist with industrial scale-up experience to help our clients get Enduro Sense working in their processes at scale.

You will be bioprocess lead on client projects. You will get to know each client's process, plan how Enduro Sense strains are tested in our lab and at the client's pilot or production site and make sure the results translate both ways.

You will report to the Director of Bioprocess Technology and work with project leads, strain engineers and the bioprocess team in Copenhagen, Denmark, as well as with clients' bioprocess and manufacturing teams.

This role is perfect for an industry-seasoned fermentation scientist who is passionate about delivering new bioprocess science to create tangible client impact while closely collaborating with a highly dedicated team. You enjoy working hands-on with the most challenging parts of a bioprocess, taking responsibility and executing lab processes with the highest standards.

You thrive in a fast-paced, innovation-driven setting, where you will establish and maintain best industry practices together with the bioprocess team, while you can keep a good overview of multiple, diverse projects..

Responsibilities

• Lead the bioprocess work on customer projects, from first review of the customer's process to lab implementation at Enduro to client campaigns at pilot and production scale

• Tech transfer in/out customer processes for our client delivery projects

• Support scale-up of Enduro Sense strains at customer sites, including run plans, sampling and data review

• Design and interpret campaigns in bioreactors at Enduro and client

• Analyse data from runs in diverse settings and turn it into clear plans and recommendations

• Present bioprocess results to customers and be their main technical contact

• Mentor fermentation scientists and associates in scale-up

Your profile

• PhD or MSc in biochemical engineering, chemical engineering, microbiology, biotechnology or similar

• +7 years of industrial experience with microbial fermentation, including scale-up to pilot and production scale

• Experience with successful tech transfer to or from pilot plants, CMOs or manufacturing sites

• Sound understanding of how scale might impact physiology and performance of the most common industrial cell factories (E coli, Pichia, Saccharomyces, Bacillus)

• Enjoying collaboration in larger teams and directly with our clients

• Fluent in English

It is a plus if you have:

• Hands-on experience with AMBR250 or other high-throughput bioreactor systems

• Experience with advanced data management of lab-scale and industrial bioprocess data

• Worked with long fermentations, incl. semi-continuous / continuous processes

• Experience from a technology provider, CDMO or other customer-facing role

• Experience working with CHO bioprocesses

• Experience mentoring colleagues or leading projects

What we offer

• A key role in bringing Enduro Sense to industrial scale with our customers

• Projects across different hosts, products and partners

• A small, ambitious team where you have a direct say in how we work

• Competitive salary, pension

Application

Send your application (CV and cover letter) on this link no later than November 30th 2026. We review applications as they come in, so please apply early.

Work address:

Ole Maaløes Vej 3

2200 Copenhagen N

Enduro Genetics

Ole Maaløes Vej 3

2200 Copenhagen N

http://enduro.bio

Enduro Genetics is a SynBio company located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Applying our game-changing synthetic biology technology Enduro Sense, we empower our partner companies to maximize their large-scale fermentations and thereby increasing the competitiveness of current and future green bioproduction.

Do you enjoy being on the move, handling logistics, and working as part of a team?

At Wulff & Konstali, we’re looking for a dedicated and reliable driver to help transport goods between our locations while ensuring smooth operations behind the scenes.

If you’re organized, enjoy working independently, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this might be the job for you!

About the Job

As a Driver & Logistics Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring our operations run smoothly by delivering goods safely and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will be:

• Transporting goods between our locations and external BOH (Brunch out of House))

• Ensuring proper handling, packing, and unloading of goods

• Contributing to a positive and collaborative work environment

• Maintaining and taking care of company transport vehicle

This role is essential in keeping our supply chain running, and we value team members who are proactive, organized, and take pride in their work.

What we offer!

• Thorough training to ensure you feel confident in your role

• A team-focused workplace that values well-being and collaboration

• The opportunity to grow within a dynamic and expanding company

• Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications

Who are you?

We’re looking for someone who:

• Has a valid driver’s license (category B) – experience with goods transport is a plus, but not a requirement

• Is in good physical condition, as the job involves some heavy lifting

• Is punctual, responsible, and able to keep an overview

• Has a positive attitude and enjoys working as part of a team

Application process

• We focus on your motivation – why do you want to work at W&K?

• If we see potential, you’ll be invited for an interview and a short driving test.

• After that, we’ll have a final conversation before welcoming you to the team!

Ready to Get Behind the Wheel?

Send your application today – we look forward to meeting you!

We are seeking an early-career RF Engineer to contribute to the design, development and validation of RF communication subsystems for nanosatellite missions.

In this role, you will support RF analysis and integration activities across UHF, VHF, S-band and X-band systems, perform link-budget analyses and help validate performance through hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

You will join our Satellite Systems Hardware team in Aalborg and collaborate closely with colleagues across RF, Hardware, and Systems Engineering. You will work with GomSpace’s flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platform and gain practical experience across simulation, laboratory testing and system-level integration. Depending on the mission, you may contribute to conventional communication subsystems, software-defined radio applications or advanced RF sensing payloads.

Your Role

As RF Engineer, you will support the development and validation of RF subsystems for satellite missions, from link-budget analysis and RF-chain modelling through integration, hardware-in-the-loop testing and over-the-air validation.

Working with experienced engineers, you will gradually build the knowledge and practical experience needed to take responsibility for increasingly complex RF engineering tasks.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Support RF subsystem analysis and technical trade-offs across frequency bands, performance and mission constraints.

• Perform link-budget analysis and RF-chain modelling.

• Contribute to the definition and documentation of RF subsystem requirements and interfaces.

• Support the integration, verification and validation of RF subsystems, including hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

• Assist with the evaluation and selection of RF front-end components across UHF, VHF, S-band and X-band.

• Prepare and carry out laboratory measurements using RF test equipment.

• Analyse test results and contribute to troubleshooting RF performance issues.

• Contribute to onboard signal-processing and data-reduction activities for RF applications.

• Document analyses, test activities and technical conclusions clearly and systematically.

• Provide technical input to mission proposals with support from experienced colleagues.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace’s NanoCom product portfolio and SDR architecture.

• Building effective working relationships with colleagues across RF, Hardware and Systems Engineering.

• Completing a link-budget analysis for an active mission with guidance from experienced colleagues.

• Performing your first hardware-in-the-loop or over-the-air RF test using GomSpace equipment.

• Documenting your analysis and test results in a clear and structured way.

• Communicating RF results and technical observations clearly to colleagues from other disciplines.

Over time, you will take increasing responsibility for RF subsystem analysis, integration and verification activities. You will contribute independently to mission proposals and projects while helping develop reusable RF models, test methods and engineering tools.

What You Bring

You are a recent graduate or early-career RF engineer who is motivated to apply your technical knowledge to real satellite systems. You enjoy combining analytical work with practical laboratory activities and want to develop your skills within an experienced multidisciplinary team.

You likely bring:

• An MSc in Electrical Engineering, RF or Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field.

• Up to one year of relevant experience in RF engineering, communication systems, testing or integration.

• A basic understanding of RF engineering principles and communication systems.

• Experience with RF analysis, simulation or laboratory measurements gained through your studies, thesis, student employment, internship or first professional role.

• Familiarity with RF simulation or engineering tools such as CST, ADS, HFSS, MATLAB, Python or similar.

• Some experience with RF test equipment, such as spectrum analysers, vector network analysers or signal generators.

• An interest in satellite communication systems, software-defined radio or digital signal processing.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good written and spoken English.

Experience from the space or aerospace industry is an advantage but is not required. Relevant academic projects, thesis work, internships and student positions will also be considered.

Knowledge of modulation schemes, communication protocols, RF payloads, ECSS standards or space-grade RF qualification would be beneficial.

Who You Are

You are curious, systematic and motivated by the opportunity to turn engineering analysis into working hardware. You enjoy learning from experienced colleagues while also taking responsibility for your own tasks and development.

You are known for:

• Technical curiosity – eager to understand how RF systems perform in practice.

• Attention to detail – careful when analysing results, conducting tests and documenting conclusions.

• Hands-on problem solving – interested in moving between simulation tools and the laboratory bench.

• Collaborative communication – comfortable working with RF, systems, payload and hardware engineers.

• Structured execution – able to plan your work, follow up on tasks and communicate when support is needed.

• Customer focus – understanding that good engineering contributes directly to the success of our customers’ missions.

• Willingness to grow – open to feedback and motivated to build deeper RF subsystem expertise.

Why Join Us

You will have the opportunity to begin or develop your RF engineering career by working on communication systems for real nanosatellite missions.

The position offers hands-on experience across RF analysis, laboratory testing and system-level integration. You will work with flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platforms while learning from experienced specialists across RF, Hardware, and Systems Engineering.

Your work will contribute to mission proposals, subsystem development and technologies that ultimately fly in space. As your experience develops, you will take on increasing technical responsibility and have the opportunity to shape the tools and methods used by the team.

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis.

If you have any questions regarding the position, do not hesitate to contact Kelly Antonini, Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager: klan@gomspace.com.

The primary workplace will be at our premises in Aalborg, Denmark. The position involves laboratory, integration and test activities and therefore requires regular on-site presence. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorised third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and CVs via email or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the application link below.

About GomSpace

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 300 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

Ready to make your mark – with clarity, care, and commitment?

Apply today or get in touch if you want to know more.

We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Tenure track Assistant professor/Associate professor Position in Materials Science and Engineering
jobs.description:
Aarhus University, Denmark

The Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering at Aarhus University invites applications for two positions at the rank of:

•   Tenure Track Assistant Professor, or

•   Associate Professor

The positions are offered within the broad field of Materials Engineering and Manufacturing, with a particular focus on participating in the department’s research and education in materials engineering, durability, emerging and advanced materials, advanced manufacturing and surface engineering. The department seeks candidates who will help shape a modern materials science profile, in research as well as in teaching, and who have demonstrated relevant experience in the field.

Expected start date

July 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible.

Research Areas

We welcome applicants with a solid background in materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, materials-focused chemical engineering, applied physics, or closely related disciplines.

We particularly encourage applications within, but not limited to, the following research themes:

Additive and hybrid manufacturing

Including metal additive manufacturing, laser-based processing and welding, joining of metallic and dissimilar materials, post-processing, surface engineering, and process characterisation and modelling.

Materials durability and advanced materials

Including materials under demanding and extreme conditions, 4D printing, bioprinting, and biofabrication, surface modification, lubrication technologies and functional surfaces.

Applicants are expected to contribute to both fundamental understanding and applied solutions, with relevance to engineering systems and industrial applications

Research and Teaching Responsibilities

The selected candidates will:

•   Teach, contribute to, and develop courses in materials science and engineering, additive manufacturing, and manufacturing processes at different levels, from foundational bachelor’s courses to specialized master’s and PhD courses

•   Contribute directly to the further development of the materials and manufacturing science curriculum at different program levels

•   Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students

•   Attract external research funding

•   Engage in knowledge exchange with industry and research partners

•   Participate in departmental and university service activities

Your Profile

We are looking for candidates who can contribute to research, education, and innovation at an international level.

To meet expectations in this role, we expect the candidate to fulfill the following requirements:

-   A PhD in materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field

-   Substantial experience conducting high-quality research in materials science and engineering, with publications in leading international journals that match career stage

-   Experience in at least one of the research areas listed above, along with familiarity with experimental, computational, or theoretical research methods

-   Interest in interdisciplinary collaboration across engineering disciplines and with industry

-   For the positions as associate professor, the applicants should, in addition, have:

-   Documented teaching experience and a clear commitment to teaching and advancing materials science courses, from introductory undergraduate instruction through master’s and PhD-level study

-   For associate professor applicants: a documented record of self-directed research leadership, external funding acquisition, supervision of PhD students, and teaching and course development at university level

Who we are

The engineering field in Aarhus University is evolving with a rapid growth in student population, major research initiatives as well as through the establishment of a number of new physical facilities in the city center of Aarhus. We have comprehensive plans for increased activities in research and education, as well as public and industrial cooperation. The  Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering  within the Faculty of Technical Sciences has cooperation with universities and advisory service providers in more than 20 countries. The engineering field at Aarhus University is well established with extensive research activities, over 700 mechanical engineering students and a long tradition of industrial cooperation that we wish to extend significantly.

What we offer

The department offers:

-   research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment

-   an exciting interdisciplinary environment with many national, international and industrial collaborators

-   a research climate encouraging lively, open and critical discussion within and across different fields of research

-   a work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities

-   a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance

Place of work and area of employment

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Mechanical and Production Engineering, Katrinebjergvej 89, DK-8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

Contact information

For more information about the position contact Head of Section of Manufacturing and Mechatronics, Professor Ramin Aghababaei (ra@mpe.au.dk / +45 9350 8956)

or Head of Section of Mechanics and Materials, Professor Michal Kazimierz Budzik (mibu@mpe.au.dk, +45 4189 3217)

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than December 8th, 2026.

Technical Sciences Tenure Track

Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:

• attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level

• to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists

• to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:

• access to research infrastructure

• capability development, including postgraduate teacher training

• a mentoring programme

• support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director - Global Service Sales M/F
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the commercial lead of a global Service business and drive its next phase of profitable growth?

KK’s Service business generates approximately DKK 800m in annual revenue and is an increasingly important contributor to the company’s growth and profitability. To build on this strong foundation, we are looking for a Senior Director, Global Service Sales to lead our international Service Sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China.

In this role, you will have overall responsibility for driving profitable growth across the Service business. You will set the commercial direction, strengthen key customer relationships and further develop our sales capabilities, while ensuring strong execution across pricing, pipeline management and business development.

Reporting to the VP Service, you will be a key member of the Service leadership team and play an important role in shaping the future direction and continued growth of the business.

Purpose of position:

We are looking for a commercially driven leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution and people leadership.

You know how to set a clear direction and turn commercial ambitions into results. At the same time, you stay close to customers, markets and your organisation, giving you a strong understanding of where the opportunities are and what it takes to capture them.

As a leader, you create clarity, accountability and momentum. You build strong teams, empower people to take ownership and bring the organisation with you as the business continues to grow.

Responsibilities

As Senior Director, Global Service Sales, you will have overall responsibility for driving the commercial development and performance of our global Service business. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Service business, driving sustainable and profitable growth across markets

• Identify and develop new business opportunities while strengthening KK’s aftermarket and Service offering

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and strategic stakeholders

• Strengthen pricing discipline, commercial decision-making and account management across regions

• Build a strong sales pipeline and improve forecasting, commercial planning and performance follow-up

• Translate market developments, customer needs and competitive insights into concrete commercial opportunities

• Lead, develop and motivate an international sales organisation across Denmark, Spain, the USA and China

• Build a strong performance culture with clear accountability, customer focus and commercial excellence

• Develop commercial capabilities and future leaders while ensuring the organisation is equipped for continued growth

• Work closely with Service Operations, Engineering, Project Management and other functions to ensure strong commercial execution

• Drive collaboration and knowledge sharing across regions and act as a visible and trusted member of the Service leadership team.

Our Requirements

We are looking for a commercially driven leader with a strong track record of delivering growth through people, customer relationships and business development.

You will likely bring:

• Significant experience in senior commercial or sales leadership roles, ideally from Service, Aftermarket or other similar recurring revenue businesses. Experience within the wind industry is advantageous.

• Responsibility for delivering profitable growth in an international business

• Experience leading teams across multiple countries and cultures

• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking

• A proven ability to build customer relationships at senior levels

• Experience operating successfully in a matrix organisation

• A structured and data-driven approach to sales management

Would you like to lead a team of scientists and help turn scientific expertise into reliable QC delivery? Join Bavarian Nordic as Manager of the Biochemistry scientist team and support the quality of vaccines that help protect lives around the world.

**Your team and leadership environment

**Biochemistry consists of 10 laboratory technicians and nine scientists organised across two teams. In this role, you will lead the scientist team and work closely with colleagues across the area.

The area performs analytical testing of raw materials, intermediates, finished products, process development samples, stability samples and control cells for extraneous agents. Techniques include physico-chemical testing, ELISA, HPLC and hemadsorption assays. Biochemistry also performs method development, validation and comparability testing.

You will join a QC department of approximately 90 employees across six teams. Our Core Leadership Team of Senior Managers works closely with First-Line Managers, the Operational Excellence Partner and a Quality Integrator to develop people and processes and maintain strong quality oversight.

QC is undergoing significant change as we support increased production demands, improve efficiency and reduce lead times. As a first-line manager, you will translate changing priorities into clear direction while maintaining employee engagement, well-being and a strong quality mindset.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead and develop the scientist team. Provide clear direction, regular feedback and individual development planning. Coach your scientists, strengthen competencies and create psychological safety while holding the team accountable for high-quality results.

• Balance scientific and operational priorities. Maintain an overview of the scientists’ workload and operational risks. Align priorities across routine analytical activities, method development, validation and comparability testing, adjusting plans as QC and manufacturing needs change.

• Ensure quality and robust processes. Ensure the team’s work complies with cGMP and the Bavarian Nordic Quality Management System. Promote data integrity, accurate documentation and inspection readiness, and help maintain robust processes across the analytical sample lifecycle.

• Strengthen collaboration and improvement. Work closely with the laboratory technician team and stakeholders across QC and manufacturing. Use data and digital tools to improve coordination, address bottlenecks and support efficient analytical workflows and reduced lead times.

**Your profile

**

• You are a people-oriented leader who can support scientific specialists, create structure and maintain momentum in a changing GMP environment. You enjoy developing others and connecting scientific work with operational priorities.

• A relevant scientific degree and experience from a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment, preferably within QC biochemistry or analytical testing.

• An understanding of analytical methods and experience relevant to method development, validation or comparability testing.

• Leadership experience from QC, a laboratory or a similar area is an advantage, with the ability to coach specialists and support their professional growth.

• A solid understanding of cGMP, data integrity and Quality Management Systems, and confidence using LIMS or other digital laboratory tools.

• An ability to prioritise competing activities, communicate expectations clearly and build effective relationships across scientific and operational teams.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic

**You will lead a scientist team whose expertise supports vaccine quality and reliable manufacturing. You will have the opportunity to develop people, strengthen scientific collaboration and influence how Biochemistry delivers both routine activities and analytical improvements.

You will join a leadership team that values coaching, employee development and shared problem-solving. In a department undergoing change, you can contribute to continuous improvement and Operational Excellence while developing professionally in an international vaccine company.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

**Apply by clicking the ‘APPLY’ button. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your CV.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives

**Improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do at Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of life-saving vaccines, and the largest pure-play vaccine company in the world.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

jobs.occupation: Student Trader for US Power Trading
jobs.description:
Join a world of energy as MFT Energy's new Student Trader for US Power Trading

Are you curious about how fast-paced markets work and motivated to learn how to make decisions based on real-time data? Then you might be our new Student Trader. We are looking for a student who is competitive, curious, and eager to learn how trading works in one of the most dynamic markets.

The job as Student Trader

You will join our US Power team and become part of a fast-growing trading setup operating in one of the world’s most dynamic energy markets.

From early on, you will work close to the market, monitoring real-time developments, supporting trading decisions, and gradually building your understanding of how trading strategies are executed in practice. You will collaborate with experienced traders, analysts, and developers, where learning is hands-on and feedback is direct.

You can look forward to

• Supporting trade execution in the US power markets, with a focus on short-term opportunities

• Assisting in the development and refinement of trading strategies

• Monitoring real-time market data and learning how to make fast, informed decisions

• Working closely with traders, analysts, and developers to improve tools and insights

• Supporting the evaluation of trading positions, with a focus on risk and performance

• Sharing observations and ideas to challenge existing approaches and improve execution

What we are looking for

• You are currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematical Economics, or a related field

• You are interested in financial or commodity markets and motivated to learn what drives them

• You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and willing to take ownership as you learn

• You think analytically and are motivated to develop structured problem-solving skills; technical skills are a plus, not a requirement

• You bring a collaborative mindset and positive, competitive energy to the team

• You are curious, proactive, and quick to learn – especially when facing new and complex challenges

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center, Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Türkiye, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world. The US Power team is located in Aarhus and New York.

We offer:

• A flexible student position (15–20 hours per week) designed to fit alongside your studies

• An international team where things move quickly, and the work changes as the market changes

• Talented and ambitious colleagues who challenge and support you as you learn

• A role with a high degree of responsibility and clear opportunities to grow - including the potential to transition into a full-time position

• A culture where we celebrate both big and small successes – and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

• Mind boggling lunch conversations (e.g. physicists explaining space-time and Schrödinger's cat or debates on the differences between wizards and sorcerers)

Make the Most of Your Talent! Join us!

If you see a match between the role and your aspirations, please send us the following information: your CV, grades, examples of potential passion projects, and answers to the four questions in the application form. No cover letter needed.

Deadline: Screening is ongoing, so apply as soon as possible.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Innovative and ambitious company within personal health technology is looking for a product management intern to support company growth.

This is a full-time unpaid internship in Copenhagen for minimum five months (starting date can be discussed) and should be part of the applicant’s education.

Key responsibilities

• Configuration of the solution to customers (app and web portal)

• Designing and drafting of app content

• Assisting in trainings and workshops for clinicians

• Assisting in product implementation in research projects and commercial clients

• Maintaining and updating our customer support system

What we offer

We offer you a fantastic opportunity to join a young company, where you truly have the ability to make an impact and help shape the future in an exciting field. Personal health technology and mHealth are booming markets worldwide. You will have the opportunity to join us on our quest to provide innovative solutions for disease management and treatment support and thereby reduce the burden of mental illness in society. Our informal, fast-paced environment will give you great opportunities to grow professionally and personally.

Desired skills and expertise

• Taking a degree in Digital Design, Psychology, Healthcare Technology, Communications or another relevant programme. In any case, technical flair is required

• Service-minded and flexible approach to providing support to customers with varying levels of technical affinity

• Structured and well-organized way of working, with good attention to detail

• Good communication skills in English and Danish – orally as well as in writing

• Able to work independently, yet good interpersonal skills

• Preferably knowledge about mHealth, health technologies and/or mental health

This is a full-time unpaid internship in Copenhagen, Frederiksberg C, for minimum five months (Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis, exact start date can be discussed individually)

For questions regarding this position contact Chief Operating Officer, Nanna Iversen by e-mail: iversen@monsenso.com

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in RNA function and gene regulation
jobs.description:
The laboratory of Ulf Vang Ørom is inviting applications for a 2-year postdoctoral position at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics at Aarhus University.

The position will focus on RNA and its role in regulating cellular pathways relevant for metabolic processes.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a 2–year position from February 1 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter with possibility for extension of the employment.

Job description
You will be working using several methods to study RNA, protein-interactions and epigenetics, often including high through-put methods. The project focuses on novel aspects linking RNA, metabolism and epigenetics, and allows for active involvement in shaping the project within its duration. You will be working with a high degree of independence and in collaboration with other researchers at the institute and internationally.

Your profile
Applicants should have a PhD degree in a relevant area and expertise with working with RNA and high through-put methods.

Applicant should have a high-quality publication record and excellent language (English) skills.

Who we are
The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (https://mbg.au.dk/en/) hosts researchers in the areas of RNA and protein biology, bioinformatics and nutrition, as well as plant research, giving great opportunities for interdisciplinary collaborations.

What we offer 
The department offers

• a well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment
• an exciting interdisciplinary environment with many national, international and industrial collaborators
• a research climate encouraging lively, open and critical discussion within and across different fields of research
• a work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities
• a workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, Universitetsbyen 81, 8000 Aarhus, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments. 

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Ulf Vang Ørom, PhD, +45 22288766

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 30 November 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Working as a student assistant in Eurowind Energy

Do you want to work for an Architectural Firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be an Construction Architecture (Bygningskonstruktør)? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of technical fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing a bachelor’s degree in architectural technology and construction management (Bygningskonstruktør)

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out Jacob Faaborg-Simonsen – jafs@arkitema.com for Aarhus/Aalborg and Adrian Balch Petersen – adpn@arkitema.com for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.

We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

NOTE

Kindly submit your CV, Cover Letter, and Portfolio. As only two attachment fields are available on the application page, please combine files where needed and upload them accordingly.

We only accept applications from active students who have not already completed an internship within their studies.

Consultant Interventional Cardiologist – PCI On-Call Service

Department of Cardiology, Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark

The opportunity
Are you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?

The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.

The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.

The position
Your primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.
Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.

What we offer

• The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
• Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
• A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
• An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
• Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
• Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
• An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.
Qualifications and experience
Essential requirements

• You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
• You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
• You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
• Or are willing to learn Danish
• You can perform PCI procedures independently.
• You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
• You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
• You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
• You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
• You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.
Desirable qualifications

• Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
• Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
• Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
• A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
• Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
• Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.
About the Department
The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.

Our department performs approximately:

• 6,000 invasive procedures annually
• 8,000 inpatient admissions annually
• More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
• Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually
Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.
We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.
Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.
The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.

Salary and terms of employment
This is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.
The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.
Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk
 
Application
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously. The advertisement will be withdrawn once the position has been filled.
Please submit your application by email to:
Ljubica Vukelic Andersen
Head of Department of Cardiology
Aalborg University Hospital, Denmark
Email: ljubica.andersen@rn.dk
Telephone: +45 30 38 25 10

Please include:

• Curriculum Vitae (CV).
• Letter of motivation
• Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
• List of publications, if applicable.
The assessment process will follow the applicable Danish requirements for consultant appointments, including assessment of competencies across the seven physician roles.

Step into a role where you can help redefine how infrastructure is delivered across a global enterprise. With strong Azure expertise, a passion for automation and Infrastructure as Code, and curiosity about the opportunities AI brings to engineering, you could be our next Engineer, Cloud Platform Lead.

Meet your future team

You will join our Infrastructure & Cloud team and become part of a transformation that is shaping the future of IT at VELUX. Our mission is to modernise and simplify how infrastructure services are delivered across the organisation, moving towards a platform-driven approach built on automation, Infrastructure as Code, cloud technologies and AI.

Working closely with Infrastructure specialists, Security teams, application teams and strategic partners, you will help establish the foundations that enable innovation across VELUX. While parts of our operational delivery are provided together with our strategic partner HCL, the focus of this role is on designing what comes next. You will help define new ways of working, strengthen our platform capabilities, increase automation and drive the transformation of infrastructure services across VELUX.

Based in either Kolding or Hørsholm, you will join a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, experimentation and continuous improvement are encouraged. Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to influence how technology is delivered across VELUX for years to come.

What We Offer

This is more than a cloud engineering role. It is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of infrastructure services at VELUX.

Microsoft Azure, Azure Arc, Infrastructure as Code and automation are key building blocks in our journey. At the same time, we are actively exploring how AI can support engineering, operations and service delivery, helping teams work smarter and focus on higher-value activities.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Evolve our Microsoft Azure platform, architecture and cloud governance

• Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines

• Build reusable patterns, self-service capabilities and standardised solutions that simplify infrastructure delivery across teams

• Explore and implement opportunities where AI can support engineering, troubleshooting, documentation and operations

• Support FinOps initiatives and improve cloud cost transparency and optimisation

• Expand and mature Azure Arc across our hybrid infrastructure environment

• Collaborate closely with Infrastructure specialists, Security teams, application teams and external service providers

• Provide technical leadership and help translate architectural ideas into scalable, reliable solutions

• Help shape the future infrastructure operating model at VELUX, driving standardisation, simplification and automation across the organisation

• Partner with our strategic operations provider, HCL, to continuously improve service delivery while strengthening internal platform and engineering capabilities

What You Will Bring

You are passionate about cloud technologies and enjoy turning complex challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You combine technical depth with a collaborative mindset and thrive in environments where technology and ways of working are continuously evolving.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure

• Bring experience with cloud architecture, governance, networking, security and monitoring

• Have worked with Infrastructure as Code and Git-based delivery workflows, preferably using Terraform

• Have experience with Azure Arc or a strong interest in hybrid cloud management

• Possess a strong automation mindset and a desire to reduce manual effort through modern engineering practices

• Are curious about AI and how it can be applied to cloud engineering and IT operations

• Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Have experience working with suppliers, managed service providers or outsourced operations

It will be an advantage if you also have experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kubernetes, Windows Server or other hybrid infrastructure technologies.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Chauffør til fælgværksted i Søborg – Hjulfix / Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix
jobs.description:
Vil du have et job, hvor du er på farten hver dag og møder kunderne ansigt til ansigt? Hos Hjulfix i Søborg søger vi en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der står for afhentning og levering af hjul og fælge hos vores kunder. Det er primært værksteder, bilforhandlere og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland.

Hos Hjulfix kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores værksted for reparation af fælge i Søborg, hvor vi renoverer, retter og lakerer omkring 10.000 fælge om året. Du bliver bindeleddet mellem kunderne og værkstedet, så din indsats har stor betydning for, at fælgene kommer sikkert frem og tilbage til tiden.

Dine opgaver

• 
Afhente og levere hjul og fælge hos værksteder og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland

• 
Planlægge din rute sammen med værkstedet, så kunderne får deres fælge til aftalt tid

• 
Håndtere og sikre hjul og fælge forsvarligt under transport

• 
Have dialog med kunderne og sikre god service ved hver levering

• 
Hjælpe til i værkstedet, når du er tilbage fra køreturen, fx med af- og påmontering og klargøring

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har kørekort kategori B (almindelig bil)

• 
Er vant til at køre varebil og kender trafikken i Storkøbenhavn

• 
Er mødestabil, pligtopfyldende og kan arbejde selvstændigt

• 
Taler dansk eller engelsk (gerne begge dele)

• 
Er serviceminded og giver gerne en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fast fuldtidsstilling, mandag–fredag

• 
Mulighed for oplæring i forskellige opgaver i værkstedet, og din løn følger med, efterhånden som du lærer nye færdigheder

• 
En helt ny varebil, som bliver din til kørslen

• 
Varierede dage, hvor du starter med morgenens køretur, og når du er tilbage, hjælper du til med opgaver i værkstedet

• 
En virksomhed i vækst med et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

Om Hjulfix
Hjulfix er specialister i renovering af alufælge, fælgopretning, lakering og diamond cut. Vi servicerer værksteder, forhandlere og private kunder i hele Danmark fra vores værksted på Gladsaxe Møllevej 21 i Søborg.

Ansøgning
Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@hjulfix.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål, kan du ringe til Adrian på 42 46 27 75.

English version: Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix

Hjulfix in Søborg is looking for a reliable, service-minded driver to pick up and deliver wheels and rims for our customers. They are mainly garages, car dealers and body shops in Greater Copenhagen and on Zealand. Our workshop repairs, straightens and refinishes around 10,000 rims a year, and you'll be the link between our customers and the workshop.

Your tasks

• 
Pick up and deliver wheels and rims across Greater Copenhagen and Zealand

• 
Plan your route with the workshop so customers get their rims on time

• 
Handle and secure wheels and rims safely during transport

• 
Talk with customers and make sure every delivery goes smoothly

• 
Help out in the workshop when you're back from your run

We expect you to

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Be used to driving a van and know Copenhagen traffic

• 
Be reliable, punctual and able to work independently

• 
Speak English or Danish (both is a plus)

• 
Be service-minded and happy to lend a hand

We offer

• 
A permanent full-time job, Monday–Friday

• 
Training in different tasks in the workshop, with your salary growing as you learn new skills

• 
A brand-new van for your driving

• 
Varied days: you start with the morning run, and once you're back you help out with tasks in the workshop

• 
A growing company with a good, informal atmosphere

How to apply
Send a short application and your CV to job@hjulfix.dk. We interview on a rolling basis. For questions, call Adrian on +45 42 46 27 75.

JKS is looking for an experienced painter to carry out wet spray painting of various metal components.

Your tasks:

• 
Spray painting various metal components

•

• 
Ensuring high quality and attention to detail

We expect you to:

• 
Have experience in spray painting and wet painting

• 
Previous experience as an industrial painter is an advantage

• 
Be able to speak English

• 
Work independently and have a quality-conscious approach

 Working hours:

• 
Monday–Thursday: 06:00–14:30

• 
Friday: 06:00–12:00

 Salary: DKK 180 per hour

Start date: As soon as possible!

Interested in the job? Contact Ewa from JKS on +45 61 20 40 70 or send an email to ewape@jks.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!
